Assemble fresh

Scoops

Mix these close to serving. Keep the greens, vegetables and scoop cool; build the bowl when ready to eat.

Fresh rule: tuna and chicken scoops are not PM components. The finished salad and greens stay fresh for a crisp bowl.

Tuna–cornichon scoop

Tuna, finely chopped celery, cornichons, Dijon, lemon, cottage cheese or Greek yogurt, black pepper and dill or parsley. Add a little flaxmeal if desired.

Make a bowl

Serve over romaine with cucumber, tomato, pickled onion, Pacha toast, walnuts or hemp and a little Mediterranean vinaigrette.

Lemon-herb chicken scoop

Freshly cooked and chopped chicken, celery, cucumber or cornichons, feta, lemon, olive oil, dill, parsley and black pepper. Walnuts optional.

Make a bowl

Serve over greens with roasted cauliflower, tomato, pickled carrot, toasted walnuts and lemon-herb tahini.

Other open-fresh proteins

Sardines, smoked sprats and canned smoked salmon need no cooking, but open and assemble them at serving. Pair with greens and fresh vegetables; add pickles, vinaigrette and toasted crunch from the PM shelf.
